issues.display_title: Issue #4290: feat(auth): migrate Keycloak login to authorization code flow + PKCE
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Replace the hand-rolled Keycloak OIDC implicit flow (response_type=token) for the hidden SSO entry (?auth=keycloak) with the standard authorization code flow + PKCE (RFC 7636). Implementation is ready on branch feat/keycloak-login-code-flow-pkce (base development, developed in a git worktree) — needs review, then Keycloak admin config before deploy.

Background

  • Implicit flow hands the Keycloak access token over in the URL fragment (browser-history exposure) and returns no refresh token and no id_token.
  • Code flow + PKCE is the OAuth 2.1 / OIDC recommended flow (implicit is deprecated); Keycloak 18+ recommends standard flow.
  • BE contract is unchanged: the FE still ends up posting a Keycloak access token to POST /v1/auth/keycloak-login — no BE change required.

Tasks (implemented on the branch)

  1. src/utils/keycloakAuth.js (new) — single source of truth for Keycloak: lazy env config (test-overridable), auth/token/callback URLs, RFC 7636 S256 PKCE pair generation, login-context persist/read/clear, exchangeKeycloakCode(), unsigned JWT payload decode, id_token store/get/clear.
  2. Login.jsx — auth request now sends response_type=code, code_challenge (S256), nonce, state; hasStartedRef guard prevents the PKCE race under StrictMode double-run; config read lazily (fixes tests that previously depended on local .env).
  3. KeycloakCallback.jsx — reads ?code (legacy #access_token fragment fallback kept for rollout safety), validates state + nonce, exchanges the code at the Keycloak token endpoint, stores the id_token (sessionStorage — will be used as id_token_hint for the SSO-aware logout), and surfaces code_exchange_failed with Keycloak's error_description.
  4. Tests — KeycloakCallback.test.jsx rewritten (exchange request body, nonce mismatch, exchange failure, legacy implicit fallback, etc.); Login.countly.test.jsx updated for the async/PKCE redirect.

Verification

  • 13/13 auth tests pass
  • eslint clean
  • Note: 3 failing tests in Schedule.test.jsx are pre-existing on development (fail without this change too)

Deploy prerequisites (Keycloak admin console — before merging/deploying)

  • Client: enable Standard flow (implicit flow can be disabled)
  • Client Web Origins includes the dashboard origin (token exchange now happens from the browser)
  • Valid Redirect URIs still covers /auth/keycloak/callback (unchanged)

Result

Implemented in #4292 (merged into development, 2026-09-16).

  • src/utils/keycloakAuth.js (new) — lazy env config, RFC 7636 PKCE pair (S256), login-context persist/read/clear, exchangeKeycloakCode(), unsigned JWT payload decode, id_token store/get/clear
  • Login.jsx — response_type=code + code_challenge (S256) + nonce + state; hasStartedRef guard against the PKCE race under StrictMode; config read lazily (tests no longer depend on local .env)
  • KeycloakCallback.jsx — ?code parsing (legacy #access_token fragment fallback kept), state + nonce validation, code→token exchange at the Keycloak token endpoint, id_token persisted for the future id_token_hint
  • Verification: 13/13 auth tests pass, eslint clean; 3 failing Schedule.test.jsx tests are pre-existing on development
  • The Keycloak admin checklist above (Standard flow + Web Origins) is still a deploy prerequisite — pending on the Keycloak console side

issues.display_title: Issue #4291: feat(auth): SSO-aware logout via Keycloak end-session endpoint (post_logout_redirect_uri)
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Make dashboard logout SSO-aware: after calling the GoThru logout API, redirect the browser to the Keycloak end-session endpoint (/protocol/openid-connect/logout) with id_token_hint + post_logout_redirect_uri, so the Keycloak SSO session dies together with the app session.

Background

  • Current logout (Header.jsx handleLogoutAction) only calls POST /v1/auth/logout, clears cookie/localStorage, then redirects to /auth. The Keycloak session is handled server-side via the Admin API, which kills all sessions of that user (every device) — see the related BE issue.
  • The standard OIDC end-session flow is more granular (only the current browser session) and takes the admin credentials out of the FE logout path.
  • Prerequisite from #4290: the login callback now stores the id_token in sessionStorage (kc_id_token) — that token is the id_token_hint.

Tasks

  1. After POST /v1/auth/logout completes (BE session deleted + sid cookie cleared), redirect to:
    {KC_BASE}/realms/{realm}/protocol/openid-connect/logout?id_token_hint=<kc_id_token>&post_logout_redirect_uri={origin}/auth
  2. Only perform step 1 redirect when the user logged in via Keycloak (id_token present in sessionStorage); password/Google logins keep today's behavior (plain redirect to /auth).
  3. Never block the Keycloak redirect if the BE logout call fails; do not rely on post_logout_redirect_uri as the primary way back — Keycloak shows its own default logout page when the URI is unregistered/mismatched.
  4. Clear kc_id_token (and any remaining kc_* context) after logout completes.
  5. Optional: have BE return the pre-built Keycloak logout URL in the logout response so the FE does not need Keycloak config just for logout.

Acceptance

  • SSO user: logout ends the Keycloak session and lands back on /auth
  • SSO user: after logout, starting SSO login again does not silently re-login
  • Password/Google user: logout behaves exactly as today (no Keycloak redirect)
  • BE logout failure still triggers the end-session redirect
  • post_logout_redirect_uri (e.g. https://<host>/auth) registered under the client's Valid post logout redirect URIs (deploy prerequisite)

Depends on #4290 (id_token availability).

Result

Implemented in #4294 (open, awaiting merge).

  • keycloakLogoutUrl() — builds the end-session URL (id_token_hint + post_logout_redirect_uri → /auth); returns null when there is no stored id_token, so password/Google logins keep today's behavior
  • Header.jsx — duplicated cleanup in both logout branches extracted into finishLogout(); SSO users → Keycloak end-session redirect; API logout failure never blocks the end-session redirect for SSO users
  • DeleteAccount.jsx — clears the stale kc_id_token after the post-deletion logout (BE Admin-API revoke covers the KC side there; /account-deleted navigation preserved)
  • Verification: 14 unit tests for the util (keycloakAuth.test.js) + SSO success/failure cases in Header.countly.test.jsx; full suite 494/497 (only pre-existing Schedule.test.jsx failures); eslint clean
  • The deploy prerequisite above (Valid post logout redirect URIs = dashboard auth page) is still pending on the Keycloak console side
